origin.description: Square Jacobian of an ODE rate function by forward differences.
origin.usage: jacobian.full(y, func, dy = NULL, time = 0, parms = NULL, pert = 1e-8, ...)

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, y, parms) returns the rates, or a list whose first element is the rates.

arguments.name: dy
arguments.text: Reference rates. NULL estimates them by calling func.

origin.details: Only the first length(y) values returned by func are kept. A short return is padded with NA. Column names are the names of y.
origin.value: A square matrix, one column per state.
origin.example:
model <- function(t, y, parms)
  list(c(-0.1*y[1] + 0.02*y[2], 0.1*y[1] - 0.2*y[2]))
y <- c(A = 1, B = 2)
jacobian.full(y, model)
